title: Heat Pump Reality Check - Gas Boiler Wins on Running Costs
summary: A UK owner uses half-hourly meter data for January 2026 to show his heat pump cost more to run than a 90% gas boiler on standard and Cosy Octopus tariffs, and only beat gas with solar and batteries.

assertions.quote: In the coldest month of the year, the heat pump cost about £42 more to run for one month than it does on gas.
when you're told that having a heat pump will save you money, the reality is for most people, that is not true
For heat pumps to beat gas on cost without the added costs of solar and batteries, electricity pricing needs to change.
it will cost you more to have a heat pump and be on cozy octopus than it would do to keep your gas boiler
So in my circumstances, with solar and batteries, a heat pump is a no-brainer.
But today, gas is cheap again. It was expensive. Now it's cheap, and that has changed the numbers.
